review_candidates.description: WE ARE HIRING: FACTORY ESTABLISHMENT & TECHNICAL OPERATIONS MANAGER Company: Opus Dei Homecare Location: Anambra State, Nigeria Employment Type: Full-time Department: Manufacturing & Operations About Opus Dei Homecare: Opus Dei Homecare is an emerging Nigerian household cleaning-products manufacturing company committed to developing quality, reliable and competitive cleaning solutions for the Nigerian market. As we expand our manufacturing operations, we are seeking an experienced Factory Establishment & Technical Operations Manager to lead the organisation, development and management of our production facility. The Opportunity This is an opportunity for an experienced manufacturing professional to take an active leadership role in establishing a growing manufacturing operation. The successful candidate will work closely with management to develop efficient production systems, establish operational standards, coordinate technical personnel and build a competent factory workforce. Key Responsibilities - Lead factory establishment and operational organisation. - Coordinate equipment installation, commissioning and operational readiness with qualified technical contractors. - Establish manufacturing workflows and standard operating procedures. - Develop production planning and management systems. - Coordinate technical product development and independent quality testing. - Establish raw-material and finished-product inventory controls. - Recruit, train and supervise production personnel. - Implement workplace safety and quality-management systems. - Coordinate manufacturing documentation and regulatory readiness. - Prepare operational budgets and management reports. Qualifications and Experience - HND or Bachelor's degree in Chemical Engineering, Industrial Chemistry, Chemistry, Manufacturing Engineering or a related discipline. - Minimum of five years of relevant industrial manufacturing experience. - Demonstrable experience in factory setup, production management or manufacturing operations. - Experience in FMCG, detergent or household cleaning-product manufacturing is strongly preferred. - Strong leadership, organisational and problem-solving abilities. - Excellent documentation and reporting skills. What We Are Looking For We are looking for a practical, disciplined and results-oriented professional who understands how to establish and manage manufacturing operations. The ideal candidate should be capable of building systems, managing people, solving operational problems and helping transform an emerging manufacturing business into a professionally managed company. Application Process Interested and qualified candidates should submit their updated CV and a brief professional profile highlighting relevant factory establishment and manufacturing experience. Application Email: opusdeihomecare2004@gmail.com Email Subject: Application – Factory Establishment & Technical Operations Manager Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. Opus Dei Homecare Opus – Power in Every Drop.

We are looking for an organized and proactive Executive Assistant to support our Director with daily task management.   Key Responsibilities Manage and organize the Director's daily tasks, priorities, and to-do lists. Monitor deadlines and proactively follow up with the Director to ensure tasks are completed on time. Provide regular reminders and progress updates on outstanding tasks. Identify overdue tasks and help prioritize important or time-sensitive work. Track progress on ongoing projects and maintain organized records. Provide general administrative and operational support as required.   Requirements Excellent organizational and time-management skills. Proactive personality with the confidence to consistently follow up with the Director regarding deadlines and commitments. Comfortable using basic technology and productivity tools, including Google Docs, Google Sheets, Microsoft Teams, Outlook, and Microsoft Office. Reliable internet connection and a quiet workspace. No prior experience required.   Working Hours Working hours will be 10:00 AM to 7:00 PM Toronto time (Eastern Time) . Ideal Candidate We are looking for someone who is highly organized, persistent, and proactive . The ideal candidate will actively manage priorities, track deadlines, follow up on commitments, and ensure nothing falls through the cracks.

review_candidates.description: Buscamos un Especialista Power BI con sólida experiencia en la transformación de datos en soluciones analíticas y métricas estratégicas. En este rol serás responsable de colaborar directamente con las áreas de negocio para entender sus necesidades, integrar múltiples fuentes de datos y diseñar dashboards interactivos y escalables que impulsen la toma de decisiones informada. Requisitos: Licenciatura o Ingeniería en Sistemas Computacionales, Tecnologías de la Información, Informática, Ciencia de Datos o carreras afines.
